name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
flagName: Flag of Saint Kitts and Nevis
summary: A black diagonal band edged in yellow, bearing two white stars, separating a green upper-hoist triangle from a red lower-fly triangle. Designed by a student, Edrice Lewis, for independence in 1983.
origin: A competition held for independence drew 258 entries. The design by Edrice Lewis, a student, was chosen and adopted on 19 September 1983, when Saint Kitts and Nevis became independent from Britain.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: The African heritage of the people.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The struggle from slavery through colonialism to independence.

symbols.name: Two stars
symbols.description: White five-pointed stars on the black band.
symbols.meaning: Hope and liberty; often read as the two islands.

facts: It is the smallest country in the Americas by area and population.
Its diagonal layout is similar to Tanzania's and Namibia's.
Saint Kitts's official name is Saint Christopher.
clues: A black diagonal band edged in yellow with two white stars, between green and red triangles.
The flag of the smallest country in the Americas.
Designed by a student for independence in 1983.
